utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive—I probably missed the latest update, so are we still meeting by the community shed, and what time was it again?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still spreading the word, but I don’t want to overstate anything—we should confirm whether it’s definitely this weekend and who finalized the schedule before I repeat the time or place.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, got it—I probably mixed things up again. Can you ping Uli or Cleo and let me know if it’s the shed on Saturday once they confirm?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yep, I’m still there early Saturday at the community shed with the signup sheet and donation box. If Opal’s checking in, we’re still on for setup and signage.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I’ve got the shed pinned for early Saturday, and I’m still grouping Maple, Cedar, and the south end of Birch so the drop-offs stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds great, Opal—I’ll be there early with the signup sheet and donation box, and I can help point folks to the right drop-off spots once the tables and signage are up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive, and I’m checking what hand tools are still missing when I stop by. If you know anyone who can lend a few basics, connect me with them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m a little maxed out, but Cleo’s asking around for work lights and Oren might bring a screwdriver set. Just text me what’s still missing and I’ll see who I can point you to.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Bo—that helps a lot. I’ll check what’s still missing when I stop by and text you, and if Cleo or Oren need anything coordinated, I’m happy to help connect people.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still waiting to hear back on the latest sign-up count and whether they need extra volunteers or tools, but I’m checking while I’m out and I’ll pass it along as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Ira—thanks for checking; if they do need extra hands or tools, I can jump in sorting by the community shed at ten.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great, Dane—I’ll keep that in mind and let you know as soon as I hear the sign-up count and what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got tape, gloves, and bottled water covered pretty well for the repair drive, but we’re still short on work lights. I’m asking around the block now and I’ll text you the count as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but are we actually confirmed for this weekend yet, and do we have the tool list and drop-off spot pinned down before anyone starts hauling things over?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: As far as I’ve heard, it’s still Saturday at the community shed, but I’m waiting on final confirmation and the tool list. I’ll text you both as soon as they lock it in so nobody hauls anything over early.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Gus, I’m hearing the repair drive still could use a few basic hand tools, though folks are already bringing spare parts and maybe extension cords. If you hear what’s still missing, tell me and I’ll keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess—that helps a lot. I’m bringing my own tools, but if you hear of anyone with extra screwdrivers, pliers, or a small hammer, send them our way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Gus—I’ll keep asking around for extra screwdrivers, pliers, and a small hammer, and I’ll send anyone I find your way.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help mid-morning after school drop-off, but can you remind me which repairs we’re covering and whether Malik’s definitely handling pickups?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m still waiting on the organizers to confirm the full repair list and whether Malik’s definitely covering pickups, but I’ll check and get back to you. Mid-morning help would be great, though.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I can do mid-morning after drop-off then — just send me the repair list and pickup update once they confirm so I can plan around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Pia, let’s keep the repair drive straightforward: we still need a couple of screwdrivers, a hammer, and a small step stool, and folks should only bring what they can carry themselves.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, but I still want one clear drop-off spot and a shared tool list before we tell more people, or we’re going to end up with duplicates and stuff scattered everywhere.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: You’re right, Pia—let’s set one drop-off spot first and make a short shared list with the screwdrivers, hammer, and step stool so everyone knows exactly what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, Uli, it’s still the community shed at the usual time, far as I remember. I’ll bring the spare screwdriver set and text before I head over, just in case.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, the shed roof’s still the main thing, and the usual time should be right. Thanks for bringing the screwdriver set, Oren.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the roof—thanks, Uli. I’ll try not to forget the screwdriver set, and I’ll text before I leave so we’re not all wandering around.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds about what I’d heard too. I can bring my screwdriver set and help with the smaller fixes if that’s still useful.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, that still sounds useful to me—I’d only heard they’d already started dropping things at the hall. I’m probably going to check there and ask what smaller jobs still need doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense. If you hear they still need basic hand tools or someone to handle little fixes at a table, would you let me know?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m starting on the shed roof first, then I’ll come by the drive and take on the simple fixes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Leo—that’ll help a lot; we’ve got it set for Saturday from 10 to noon at the community shed, and we’re keeping it to small appliances, lamps, and hand-carried tools while I confirm the drop-off flow and truck help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—I’ll finish the shed roof, then come by Saturday and take whatever small fixes you’ve got ready.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Rosa, have you heard the current sign-up count for the repair drive, and do they still need more volunteers or any specific tools?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I haven’t heard the latest sign-up count yet, Mina, but we’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center and I’m still lining up volunteers. If you’ve got a basic toolkit or can lend a hand, that would be wonderful while I confirm the final needs.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay—how many volunteers do you have lined up right now, and should I tell people to bring basic toolkits for Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Sam—have we settled the tool list and the drop-off spot yet, or should I start sorting tools now?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: We haven’t fully settled it yet, so hold off a minute—I’m checking with the organizers for the current tool list and the drop-off spot, and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I'll hang tight a minute, and once you hear back I can jump straight into sorting tools or whatever else needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we actually locked in for this weekend, then, and has anyone confirmed the tool list and drop-off spot yet?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Not fully locked in yet—we’re still waiting on the exact time and drop-off spot from Ira. Rosa’s got the signup ready, and once the location’s confirmed I’ll add it with the addresses so we can sort who’s closest.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so not confirmed yet then—can you let me know once Ira locks the time and drop-off spot, and once the tool list’s settled too?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, have you heard the latest sign-up count for the repair drive, and do they still need more volunteers or any specific tools?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I haven’t heard the latest sign-up count yet, but I do know they were still sorting out basic hand tools, and Mara may be bringing extension cords. I’m planning to check what’s still missing when I stop by, then I’ll spread the word so more folks can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks—when you stop by, can you ask for the current sign-up count too, and confirm exactly which hand tools they still need?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still coming early to the community shed Saturday with the signup sheet and donation box—are you still bringing that spare screwdriver set?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, I’ve got the screwdriver set, and I’m still starting on the shed roof first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thanks, Leo — I’ll be there early for the tables and signage, so I’ll look for you by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that lines up with what I’d been hearing second-hand—sounds like the hall’s the best place to check what they still need, then.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That makes sense, but before people start bringing things, can we confirm the hall as the one drop-off spot and get a quick tool list nailed down?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I’d heard the hall was where folks were already taking things, but I’d check with Mara or whoever’s there before anyone starts hauling more over.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo—I’ll text you the time later today. The shed roof’s the main thing, and I really appreciate you bringing your tools.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—text me the time, and I’ll bring my tools for the shed roof Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo—I’ll send the time later today. It means a lot to have your help with the roof Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Gus, before I tell anyone it’s on, can we confirm whether the repair drive is definitely this weekend and who finalized the schedule?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it’s on for this weekend as far as I know, and I’ve been the one pulling the schedule together—just waiting on one last check before I tell folks it’s fully locked.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — before I pass that along, can you confirm the last check and whether the repair list and Malik’s pickup role are both finalized?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help mid-morning after school drop-off, and I’ll double-check that it’s small household fixes and bike repairs and whether Malik’s definitely doing pickups.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That helps a lot, thanks — from what I’ve heard it’s still small household fixes and bike repairs, and I’m waiting on final confirmation about Malik’s pickups. I’ll text you as soon as I’ve got the time and the work light count too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks — mid-morning still works for me after drop-off, and once you text the timing and whether Malik’s confirmed for pickups, I can plan around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Rosa, word is the repair drive still needs a couple of screwdrivers, a hammer, and a small step stool, and folks should only bring what they can carry themselves.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess—that’s helpful. I’ll add those items to the list and make sure everyone knows the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, with only easy-to-carry tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Rosa—that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep passing along that it’s Sunday at the community center and that they’re after a couple of screwdrivers, a hammer, and a small step stool.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Still no fresh count yet, but I’m checking with the organizers today and I’ll pass along whether they need more volunteers or any specific tools as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—thanks, Ira. I’ll plan on the community shed at the usual time for now, and I can bring my spare screwdriver set if I don’t forget it again.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds good for now, Oren—I still haven’t heard the latest count, but I’ll let you know right away if the organizers ask for more volunteers or specific tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Rey, I’m inviting folks for the mid-morning repair drive, but can you confirm the repair list, drop-off spot, and whether Malik’s definitely doing pickups so I can spread the word cleanly?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I don’t know the full list myself yet—I heard Faye was double-checking it and confirming whether Malik’s definitely handling pickups. I’ve mostly just heard about small fixes and tools so far.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it—I’ll ping Faye and Eli so we can lock the repair list and pickup plan, then I’ll spread one clean update around the block.
